description: This file defines a React functional component 'DTButton' that serves as a styled button with various visual and behavioral props. It includes types for props, styling classes for different sizes and variants, and implements the button's rendering logic. The file acts as a UI primitive component within a design system, replacing previous button class usage.

methods.name: DTButton
methods.description: React functional component that renders a styled button with configurable props for variant, size, fullWidth, disabled, onClick, children, type, className, and style.
